Name: Stardew Event Gallery - Browse and Replay Cutscenes
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
[color=#b45f06][size=5]Stardew Event Gallery[/size][/color]
                     Ever wanted to replay your favourite heart events, revisit memorable cutscenes, or discover events added by your favourite mods? [b]Stardew Event Gallery[/b] brings them all together in one convenient in-game interface!
Browse hundreds of discovered events, filter them by character, heart events, festivals, story progression, quests, marriage, secrets, overnight events, or modded content. Use the search bar to find events by name, ID, or location, and bookmark your favourites for quick access.

[line]
Automatic Modded Event Discovery: Stardew Event Gallery automatically scans for and discovers events from your installed mods, bringing compatible modded cutscenes into the gallery alongside vanilla events. No need to manually enter event IDs or configure each mod individually!
[line]

Features
[list]
[*][b]Event Browser:[/b] Explore hundreds of discovered vanilla and modded events.[/*]
[*][b]Character Filters:[/b] Browse events using NPC portraits.[/*]
[*][b]Multiple Categories:[/b] Find heart events, festivals, quests, story events, and more.[/*]
[*][b]Search:[/b] Locate events by name, event ID, or location.[/*]
[*][b]Favorites:[/b] Bookmark events you want to revisit.[/*]
[*][b]Event Details:[/b] View available information about event locations, requirements, triggers, and source mods.[/*]
[*][b]Safety Classification:[/b] Identify potential risks before playing an event.[/*]
[*][b]Replay Options:[/b] Attempt normal playback or use Force Play when an event's requirements aren't met.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=4]How to Use[/size][/b]
[b]Step 1 — Open the Event Gallery[/b]
            Launch Stardew Valley with the mod installed and open the gallery using its configured opening method.
[b]Step 2 — Choose a category[/b]
            Select [b]All Events[/b], [b]Heart Events[/b], [b]Modded Events[/b], or another category from the left panel.
[b]Step 3 — Select a character (optional)[/b]
            Use the character portraits along the top to narrow down the event list.
[b]Step 4 — Find your event[/b]
           Scroll through the results or use the search bar to locate a specific event.
[b]Step 5 — Review event information[/b]
           Click an event to examine its location, requirements, and safety classification.
[b]Step 6 — Play the cutscene[/b]
Choose one of the available playback options:
🟢 [b]Play Event[/b] — Attempts to play the selected event through the normal playback path.
🟠 [b]Force Play[/b] — Attempts to bypass normal event requirements.
[b]Force Play should be used with extreme caution.[/b]
[line]

⚠️ Important Caution
This mod plays actual in-game events, not prerecorded videos. Some cutscenes can modify your save, including friendship points, heart levels, quests, inventory, event flags, and story progression. Replaying an event may apply these effects again.
[b]Force Play is especially risky.[/b] Events may depend on specific locations, characters, prerequisites, or modded systems.
